messages.content: Good morning. I'm Tan Lee Khim, QA Lead for UC Platform Engineering Maxis Business. Tenant id `tnt-mxbiz-uc-001`. Hari ini saya nak run regression test plan untuk UC platform Cyberjaya cluster — kami nak validate yang fixes minggu lepas tidak regress audio quality KPI. Boleh tolong define a quality threshold profile dulu, then create test plan?
Good morning Madam Tan, thank you for reaching out to UC QA Operations. I will start by defining the quality threshold profile for your regression run. Please hold on for a moment.

- **Profile ID:** `qtp-uc-audio-v3.2` — 6 thresholds, warning 5% / critical 15% breach

Now I will create the test plan. Could you confirm environment id and the suites you want included?
Environment id `env-uc-cyberjaya-stg`. Suites: audio_quality_smoke, audio_quality_load, video_call_smoke, conference_3party. Tag test plan with 'post-hotfix-2026-05-w20'.
Certainly, Madam. I will create the test plan with the four suites.

Madam, root cause sangat jelas:

**Threshold evaluation: FAILED WITH CRITICAL**
- Jitter: 16.2% breach (CRITICAL — >15% threshold)
- Packet loss: 18.8% breach (CRITICAL)
- MOS: 5.6% breach (warning)

**Incident `inc-uc-77821-001` (CRITICAL)**
- Title: Audio quality degradation on `uc-media-cb-04` under load > 180 concurrent calls
- **Root cause hint:** Hotfix-2026-05-w20 introduced new RTP jitter buffer config; nilai default tidak mencukupi untuk 180+ concurrent
- CPU `uc-media-cb-04` melonjak ke 89% semasa tetingkap kegagalan
- Korelasi: kernel queue drops di eth1

**Remediation candidates:**
1. Rollback RTP jitter buffer config
2. Increase media server CPU quota

Mahu saya tarik butiran incident penuh dan propose remediation dengan rollback option 1?
Yes — get incident details lengkap, sambil tu propose dan apply remediation: rollback RTP jitter buffer config. Mode 'apply_then_validate'.
Sangat baik, Madam. Saya tarik butiran dan propose+apply remediation serentak.

Yes — schedule regression test selepas remediation untuk memastikan no side effect, dan retry failed test cases dari run asal. Mode parallel untuk lain-lain test case yang failed.
